data.narrative:
Freenome is a publicly traded biotech company valued at $1.1B after raising $1.3B+. The valuation is assessed against a peer universe of 11 companies (3 public, 8 private) in the Biotech & Health sector, including Recursion Pharmaceuticals, Alto Neuroscience, Chai Discovery, and New Limit.

The peer-median method is applicable and anchors the analysis. A cohort of 5 same-sector peers with similar valuation tiers yields a median valuation of $1.6B, with a range spanning $539M (Eikon Therapeutics, Series B) to $3.8B (Chai Discovery, Series C). Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales multiples cannot be applied—the median P/S across 3 public biotech tickers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) is 6.6x, but Freenome's revenue is not on file, precluding a revenue-multiple calculation.

The single applicable triangulation method supports a valuation range of $1.4B to $1.8B, with a median of $1.6B. Freenome's current $1.1B valuation sits below this peer-derived range, suggesting a potential gap of $300M–$700M to the median benchmark. Key uncertainties include revenue visibility (absent from available data) and heterogeneity within the peer set, which spans Series B through public stages and spans a $3.3B spread. Additional methods anchored to profitability, growth trajectory, or deal multiples would strengthen conviction.
